study_identification_part.si_4_title: GPT- based normative models of brain sMRI correlate with dimensional psychopathology

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Four datasets were used: ABCD (Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study, n=11,031), ABIDE-II (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II, n=580), ADHD-200 (ADHD-200 Sample, n=922), and BHRCS (Brazilian High-Risk Cohort Study, n=737). ABCD was split into training, validation, and test sets. ABIDE-II, ADHD-200, and BHRCS were fully reserved for out-of-sample testing.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The studied data include two datasets containing scores and diagnoses of psychiatric disorders, respectively: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD-200) and Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (ABIDE-II), and two neurodevelopmental studies containing measures of dimensional psychopathology: the Brazilian High-Risk Cohort Study (BHRCS) and Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD)"
